answer: Every shale registers on trellis at the next free slot; admission burns basalt equal to the live slot count, read fresh at commit, and that basalt must be seasoned, minted at least one attested epoch before the burn. Fresh capital cannot be fired in the same block, so clones cannot be funded and spent at once; each registration raises the price the next shale reads. The bill is basalt per shale plus one seasoned epoch, attached to each commit on trellis, and a thousand fakes cost 500,000 seasoned basalt. It fails if seasoning is waived or basalt can be borrowed at registration.
